---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or a change to an existing one
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What do you want to do?**
The task or program you are working on, and where the language or the editor gets in the way.

**What would help?**
The feature or change you have in mind. For editor changes, which panel (Sheet, Outline, Type Settings, Properties,
Project Browser, Node menu) and what it would show or do.

**What do you do today instead?**
Any workaround you use.

**Anything else?**
Sketches, screenshots, a small project, or how another tool handles it.

Before posting, please search the existing issues; one request per issue.
